svs-5313.title: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
svs-5313.scientists: Zhuosen Wang (University of Maryland), Miguel Roman (Leidos), Ranjay Shrestha (SSAI), Srija Chakraborty (USRA), Virginia Kalb (NASA)
svs-5313.datasetCredits: Black Marble (Black Marble: Next Generation) [Suomi NPP: VIIRS], "NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Roman, NASA GSFC."
svs-5313.description: flat map of night lights; annual averages 2012-2023, then change (PURPLE = increase, ORANGE = decrease), then zoomed views of India, Ukraine, Western Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Wide aspect ratio version made for the NASA Earth Information Center.
svs-5313.notes: In the "change" part, PURPLE = increase, ORANGE = decrease; first part = annual averages 2012-2023; later part has zoomed views of India, Ukraine, Western Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean.

svs-3912.title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
svs-3912.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
svs-3912.visualizers: Greg Shirah (NASA/GSFC); Animators: Greg Shirah, Horace Mitchell (NASA/GSFC), Eric Sokolowsky (Global Science and Technology, Inc.); Producer: Michael Starobin (HTSI)
svs-3912.description: sea surface currents coloured by sea surface temperature, from ECCO2 model output (surface flows only).
svs-3912.notes: Temperature scale: -3°C (deep blue) through 12°C (sky blue) to 22°C+ (white). Surface currents show fluid flow circulation across global ocean basins.

svs-5425.title: Perpetual Ocean 2: Western Boundary Currents
svs-5425.visualizers: Greg Shirah (NASA/GSFC), Horace Mitchell (NASA/GSFC); Technical support: Laurence Schuler, Ian Jones (ADNET Systems, Inc.); Producer: Kathleen Gaeta (Advocates in Manpower Management, Inc.)
svs-5425.scientists: Atousa Saberi (NASA/GSFC), Josh Willis (JPL); Producer: Kathleen Gaeta (Advocates in Manpower Management, Inc.)
svs-5425.datasetCredits: BMNG Blue Marble imagery (courtesy of Reto Stockli, NASA/GSFC), ECCO2 (NASA/JPL), ETOPO-30 (NOAA)
svs-5425.description: rotating globe of ocean currents, zoom to the Kuroshio Current, the Agulhas Current and the Gulf Stream, using the ECCO-2 ocean model.
svs-5425.notes: White and cyan swirling current streamlines against oceanic depths; highlighting high-energy western boundary currents.
